edits.before: Facility utilization is computed at the 3-hour production-period level for both the hydrogen supply stage and the synthetic aviation fuel synthesis stage. For each period the utilization rate is the ratio of actual production (kg) to the maximum achievable output given installed capacity and period length. Hydrogen utilization uses installed production or purification capacity where available. For integrated routes without a separate hydrogen module, peak hourly supply over the selected horizon is used as the denominator. GTL-BH follows this peak-supply convention; its hydrogen curve describes a normalized supply profile rather than installed-equipment utilization.
edits.after: Facility utilization is computed for each three-hour production period as actual output divided by installed hourly capacity and period length. Hydrogen utilization uses selected electrolyzer capacity in the electrolysis configurations and selected conditioning capacity in the by-product-hydrogen configurations. The GTL comparator has no external hydrogen-production module and no H₂ utilization distribution.
edits.paragraph_after: Facility utilization is computed for each three-hour production period as actual output divided by installed hourly capacity and period length.
